title: 672 Western Lake Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 672 Western Lake Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 12)- Parking for 2 Cars - 6 Passenger Street Legal Electric Cart - 6 Adult Bikes Included - Large Outside Balcony and Porches- Propane Grill- Exterior Shower- Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Park District- 4 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 2 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access- 4 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 672 Western Lake Drive, a stunning 5-bedroom home in the heart of WaterColor’s Park District, just steps from the Boathouse Pool & Beach Club. As you enter, you're greeted by a spacious open layout featuring a cozy living room, perfect for gatherings around the flat-screen TV, and an oversized bar for easy cocktail access. The luxurious kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, custom countertops, and a dining area that seats eight, making it an entertainer’s dream. A first-floor king bedroom with an ensuite bath adds convenience. On the second floor, the master suite offers a private bath, walk-in shower, and access to a large balcony with two elegant couches. Another king suite features a sitting area and a private bath with a jetted soaking tub, while a fun pink bunkroom sleeps four with its twin-over-twin bunks and a bath nearby. Need extra space? The charming carriage house off the porch includes a king bed, private bath, and a cozy breakfast nook. Embrace outdoor living with sprawling porches perfect for al fresco dining or reading your favorite book. Explore 30-A in style using the complimentary 6-seater electric cart or one of six cruiser bikes. Your unforgettable WaterColor escape awaits at 672 Western Lake Drive!
